text.A: **Aquesta política s’aplica siguis on siguis.** Complim la legislació de protecció de dades del Regne Unit i, quan també s’aplica la legislació de protecció de dades del país on vius, també complim aquesta.
text.B: **Notes sobre al·lèrgies i dieta.** Les transmetem al food truck juntament amb la comanda i no les utilitzem per a res més. Les eliminem, juntament amb el teu nom i les teves dades de contacte, 12 mesos després de la comanda (consulta l’apartat 7).
text.C: **Transferències internacionals.** Les dades del teu compte i de les comandes es desen i es tracten al Regne Unit. Algunes coses es gestionen fora del Regne Unit: l’extracció de cartes i les respostes automàtiques de WhatsApp, que utilitzen un servei de Google als Estats Units; el lliurament de missatges de WhatsApp, que gestiona Meta als Estats Units; els pagaments, que gestiona Stripe als Estats Units; i les notificacions push, que lliuren Apple i Google als Estats Units. Quan les dades surten del Regne Unit, la transferència està coberta per les normes d’adequació del Regne Unit o per l’International Data Transfer Agreement o l’Addendum i, quan la llei del teu país ho exigeix, per una garantia que aquesta llei reconeix. Ens pots demanar els detalls de les garanties que s’hi apliquen.
text.G:
Les nostres [Condicions del servei](/terms) s’apliquen a tots els països on s’utilitza HatchGrab. Alguns països tenen normes addicionals. Aquesta pàgina les recull, país per país.

Quan un dels apartats següents t’afecta, forma part de les nostres Condicions del servei. Si diu alguna cosa diferent del que diuen aquests documents, per a aquell país preval aquesta pàgina.

Si el teu país no hi figura, no hi ha normes addicionals: les Condicions del servei s’apliquen tal com estan redactades. La nostra [Política de privadesa](/privacy) és la mateixa a tots els països.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We comply with the data protection legislation of the United Kingdom and, where the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that too.
back.B: **Notes on allergies and diet.** We pass them to the food truck together with the order and do not use them for anything else. We delete them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: Where data leaves the United Kingdom, the transfer is covered by the UK adequacy rules or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or the Addendum and, where the law of your country requires it, by a safeguard that this law recognises.
back.D:
## 8. Your rights

Under the data protection legislation of the United Kingdom and, where it applies, the law of the country you live in, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged]

The law of the country you live in may recognise these rights for you under other names, or additional rights. You have those rights too.

**Making a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We will check that the request is genuine before acting. You can ask another person to make the request for you, and we will not treat you differently for having made one. We will reply within one month, or sooner if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to it, because it is the food truck that decides how your order data is used. If we reject a request, you can ask us to examine it again by replying to our answer.

**Deleting the account.** [unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also delete its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep.

**Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the law of the country you live in allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each one says who sends it, includes our postal address and explains how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop sending them, we will, at no cost and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by text message, you will receive them only if you agree, and you can stop them at any time.

**If something goes wrong.** If a security breach affecting your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will tell you and the supervisory authority as soon as we can where the law requires it, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so.

**Complaints.** Tell us first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would like the chance to put it right. You can also complain to the data protection authority of the country you live in. In the United Kingdom, it is the Information Commissioner's Office, at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.
